mapper.select: SELECT A.WIDGET_ID AS widgetId , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.WIDGET_NAME AS widgetName , A.DATASET_ID AS datasetId , A.STYLE_ID AS styleId , A.CATEGORY_CD AS categoryCd , CAST(A.MAPPING_JSON AS CHAR) AS mappingJson , CAST(A.CONFIG_JSON AS CHAR) AS configJson , CAST(A.FILE_SQ AS CHAR) AS fileSq , A.USE_FL AS useFl , A.CREATION_ID AS creationId , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS creationDt , A.UPDATE_ID AS updateId , DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateDt FROM CM_WIDGET A WHERE A.WIDGET_ID = #{widgetId} AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}

SELECT A.AUTHOR_CD AS authorCd , B.AUTHOR_NM AS authorNm , B.AUTHOR_CN AS authorCn FROM CM_WIDGET_AUTHOR A INNER JOIN CM_AUTHOR B ON A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.AUTHOR_CD = B.AUTHOR_CD WHERE A.WIDGET_ID = #{widgetId} AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND IFNULL(A.USE_FL, 'Y') = 'Y' AND IFNULL(B.USE_FL, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.AUTHOR_CD ASC
SELECT FILE_DATA AS fileData , MIME_TY AS mimeTy FROM CM_FILE WHERE FILE_SQ = CAST(#{fileSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND FILE_DATA IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CM_FILE WHERE FILE_SQ = CAST(#{fileSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND FILE_TY = 'WIDGET'
